dataset: CubiCasa5k (Kalervo et al. 2019), https://zenodo.org/record/2613548, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Only aggregate results are stored here; no plan content.
procedure: scripts/cubicasa_calibrate.py (pre-registered in its docstring): 300 single-floor plans with a bedroom, a living room and an entrance; gate: window and reachability quiet on >= 90 % of plans; seeded defects must be caught.

runs.verdict: gate failed; causes named from images: open-plan kitchen alcoves, garages/plant rooms with own external door, unlabelled spaces
gate passed, but seeded-defect recall dropped (283/278 of 300): exposed two extraction bugs (doorways read as open plan; balcony doors read as entrances)
window PASSED (95.0 %); reachability FAILED (87.3 %). Remaining flags come from door-to-room association across thick walls (whole plans unreachable) - an extraction limit, not a check definition.

runs.run: diagnostic only: run-1 plans re-scored with final checks (not a gate: these plans were used to design the amendment)

status.window: calibrated on real plans (final held-out gate passed)
status.reachability: NOT calibrated (final held-out gate failed, 87.3 % < 90 %); next: associate doors to rooms across wall thickness, judge on plans 901-1200
status.window_seeded_recall: 277 of 300 on the final sample: 23 bedrooms read as open to a neighbour through gaps in drawn walls (extraction)
